title: calamagrostis neglecta subsp. holmii
intro: Calamagrostis neglecta subsp. holmii, commonly known as Holm's bent-grass or Holm's reed-grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Calamagrostis neglecta subsp. holmii include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
